headline: Nvidia's beat lifts Asia's chipmakers, but software is the new weak spot
tone: Cautious relief: Nvidia cleared the bar and Seoul and Taipei bounced, but Hong Kong and China stayed soft and Tuesday's selling moved from chips into software. That reads as relief for AI hardware, not a broad return of risk appetite.
body: Nvidia's results and sales outlook beat expectations after Tuesday's close, and Asia's chip-heavy markets in Korea and Taiwan rebounded this morning. The board's line that Jensen Huang will not return keeps leadership the open question, so the beat steadies the AI hardware trade without settling it.

Tuesday's damage shifted from chips to software: Salesforce, Intuit and ServiceNow led the US losers, and Europe sold off almost across the board, with Deutsche Bank, SAP and ASML hit hardest and energy the only shelter.

Gold slid to its lowest in more than a year on a firm dollar and the US rate outlook. Lisa Cook's refusal to attend a Trump-convened hearing keeps Fed independence in the background ahead of tonight's FOMC minutes.

What would change the tone: Europe's chip names failing to follow Asia at the open, or the software rout dragging on tech as a whole. UK and euro-area inflation this morning and the FOMC minutes tonight decide how much rate relief the market can price after the dollar's run.

views.text: A beat that lifts Seoul and Taipei but not Hong Kong says the relief is about hardware demand. Today's test is whether ASML and Europe's equipment makers trade the beat they missed on Tuesday, or whether software keeps the pressure on tech.

Narrower cracks point to refiners catching up rather than demand fading, and slightly lower US LNG feedgas is a small loosening for Europe while storage sits below its five-year range. In Nordic power, Sweden and Finland's nuclear recovery eased Wednesday's prices, but Forsmark 3 and the SE3–SE4 transfer cut stay out until Friday, so the south still leans on imports.

risk_label: Our read: cautious relief overnight, hardware up, software and gold weak · written 06:16 Zurich
